giffy_hb_c89 static font pack format v0.14

Runtime tables are plain C arrays. The runtime never owns or allocates them.

Core tables:
- ghb_cmap_pair[]: Unicode scalar -> glyph id
- ghb_advance_pair[]: glyph id -> advance 26.6
- ghb_glyph_class[]: base/mark/ligature/join flags
- ghb_single_sub[]: GSUB single substitutions
- ghb_ligature[]: GSUB ligatures
- ghb_kern_pair[]: GPOS-like pair advances
- ghb_mark_anchor[] / ghb_mark_mark_anchor[]: mark positioning
- ghb_context_class_range[] / ghb_context_class_sub[]: compact contextual GSUB
- ghb_context_pair_adjust[]: compact contextual GPOS pair adjustment
- ghb_script_lang[]: script/lang inventory
- ghb_var_axis[] / ghb_var_region[] / ghb_hvar_item_delta[]: static variation data

v0.14 additions:
- trace stages can be filtered with ghb_buffer_set_trace_stage_mask()
- trace ring can be copied by stage with ghb_buffer_copy_trace_ring_stage()
- HVAR diagnostics are available via ghb_font_get_hvar_diagnostics()
- generated headers include v0.14 notes from the packer
